authority: TGT-020 and MATRIX-017; prospective release target, not observed performance

hardware.model: Record exact chip and memory in receipt; no cross-machine latency equivalence

method.measure: monotonic wall clock from action to usable result
method.failure_policy: Any missing sample, error, timeout, mismatched fixture hash or hardware class fails the applicable gate
method.isolation: Use the signed release artifact on a clean supported Mac for final desktop claims; record OS, chip, power mode, browser, app/version/commit/artifact hashes

fixtures.action: launch installed app to first authorized, interactive view
fixtures.input: fresh profile and existing empty profile, separately

fixtures.action: tap navigation and open a saved conversation until settled
fixtures.input: 100 conversations with 20 turns each; 390x844 responsive view and desktop view separately

fixtures.action: ingest text/PDF fixture until indexed and source count reconciles
fixtures.input: 10 MiB UTF-8 text plus 20-page text PDF; freeze fixture hashes
RT-10 v1.2 corpus and 80-query denominator; use PR #138 only after exact-head execution

fixtures.action: OCR 10 raster pages and emit source-bound text
fixtures.input: 300 dpi, English/Spanish page set with varied layout; freeze source and gold text hashes and OCR engine

fixtures.action: clip/reproject/validate one supported vector fixture and one raster fixture
fixtures.input: 100000 polygon features and 1024x1024 raster, CRS/geometry/schema frozen; confirm output equivalence

fixtures.action: generate 128 output tokens after 512 input tokens with local model
fixtures.input: pin an openly redistributable 3B class Q4 model file hash and engine build before execution; if unavailable remain OPEN

fixtures.action: export cited answer and provenance receipt
fixtures.input: 100 citations and 20 source bindings; compare generated schema and logical hashes

limitations: These are prospective budgets, not measurements or PASS evidence.
Fixture creation and exact hashes remain OPEN where stated.
A synthetic RT-10 result cannot certify real-world OCR, GIS, mobile Safari, or signed desktop performance.
Threshold changes require a versioned replacement and cannot be selected after looking at final-run results.
